findings.title: Client asset safeguards via modular compliance
findings.explanation: Runtime hint: ABI missing compliance.addModule(address).. Deterministic testing highlighted behaviour that is inconsistent with SFO (Cap.571) §53ZRK(5)(e) and could undermine investor protections if left unresolved.
findings.recommendation: Align the implementation with SFO (Cap.571) §53ZRK(5)(e), add an automated regression test that fails if the gap reappears, and record the fix for compliance evidence.
